title: Frequency Leaderboard
description: Given an integer array, return the value with the highest frequency. If multiple values have the same highest frequency, return the smallest value.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n integers.
hints: Build a frequency map, then compare frequency first and value second.

examples.explanation: 4 occurs three times, more than every other value.
All three values occur twice, so the smallest value wins the tie.
